data.narrative:
Skydio, a Series F autonomous systems company in Defense & Security, is valued at $4.4B post-money and has raised $825M+ to date. The valuation assessment draws from a peer set of 10 comparable companies spanning public and private markets: 2 public comps (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, applying a typical 1.3x step-up multiplier from Series F forward progression, implies a valuation of $5.7B. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Helsing at $18.0B Series E, Shield AI at $12.7B Series G, and Flock Safety at $7.5B Series G) yields a median of $12.7B, establishing a range of $7.5B to $18.0B.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $4.9B to $14.6B, with a median of $9.2B. The current $4.4B post-money sits at the lower bound, reflecting the company's Series F stage relative to later-stage peer valuations. Key uncertainties include timing to Series G, competitive positioning within the crowded autonomous defense market, and revenue scale relative to peer multiples. The 1.3x stage multiplier and peer sample size of three represent moderate conviction points.
